name: humanize
description: Write and rewrite text for people as short and plain as possible without losing meaning: removes AI writing patterns, fixes usage, and keeps every fact, condition and tone. For commit messages, PR descriptions, docs, changelogs, emails and review comments.

interface.shortDescription: Write and rewrite text plainly without losing meaning
interface.longDescription: Rewrites drafts and writes new text for people as short and plain as possible. It removes 30 common signs of AI writing, fixes grammar and usage, and checks that every fact, condition, number and tone survives.
defaultPrompt: Use $humanize to rewrite this draft so it sounds natural.
Use $humanize to write the commit message for this change.
Use $humanize to score this file for AI writing patterns without rewriting it.
Use $humanize to preview a rewrite of CHANGELOG.md without editing it.
